item_name: Rothco Deluxe Heavy Duty Camp Axe
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Deluxe Heavy Duty Camp Axe is a staple in any outdoor pack with a strong steel composition that is perfect for camping, bushcraft, bugout bags, and more.
description: Rothco’s Deluxe Heavy Duty Camp Axe is a staple in any outdoor pack with a strong steel composition that is perfect for camping, bushcraft, and more. The powerful carbon steel axe head cuts wood with ease, while the blunt axe head back functions as a hammer for securing tent stakes and more. The camping axe features an ergonomic rubberized no-slip grip handle and a durable polyester sheath that protects the blade while carrying. The hatchet also features a rubber blade protector for safe use of the hammer edge.
